content.text: I need to price the example plan with a 12% discount to show the impact. Let me calculate that for you.

For the requested 12% discount (1200 bps), revenue declines from 51,000 cents to 44,880 cents, a change of -6,120 cents [E1]. Gross margin falls from 31,000 cents to 24,880 cents (-6,120 cents), and margin percentage drops from 60.78% to 55.44% (-534 bps) [E1]. **Approval authority**: This discount requires sign-off from the VP of Sales or Chief Revenue Officer, as it materially impacts margin on the example plan. Proceed only with documented business justification (e.g., competitive win, strategic account retention).
